title: Dependency Parsing Across the Resource Spectrum: Evaluating Architectures on High and Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2605.02608v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformer-based models achieve state-of-the-art dependency parsing for high-resource languages, yet their advantage over simpler architectures in low-resource settings remains poorly understood. We evaluate four parsers---the Biaffine LSTM, Stack-Pointer Network, AfroXLMR-large, and RemBERT---across twelve typologically diverse languages, with a focus on low-resource African languages. We find that the Biaffine LSTM consistently outperforms transformer models in low-resource regimes, with transformers recovering their advantage as training data increases. The crossover falls within a resource range typical of treebanks for under-resourced languages. translated_title: 跨资源光谱的依存句法分析：在高资源与低资源语言上评估各类架构
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的模型在高资源语言上实现了最先进的依存句法分析，但它们在低资源环境中相比更简单架构的优势仍鲜为人知。我们在十二种类型多样的语言上评估了四种解析器——双仿射LSTM（Biaffine LSTM）、栈指针网络、AfroXLMR-large和RemBERT——重点关注低资源的非洲语言。我们发现，双仿射LSTM在低资源情形下始终优于Transformer模型，而随着训练数据的增加，Transformer模型重新获得优势。这一交叉点恰好落在资源匮乏语言树库的典型资源范围内。在控制语料库规模后，形态复杂性（通过MATTR测量）成为Transformer相对劣势的显著次要预测因子。这些结果表明，双仿射LSTM可能更适合用于低资源环境下的句法工具开发。
tldr: 研究发现双仿射LSTM在低资源语言的依存句法分析中持续优于Transformer模型，而Transformer的优势仅在训练数据充足时才显现，表明低资源句法工具开发应优先采用双仿射LSTM架构。
en_tdlr: The Biaffine LSTM consistently outperforms Transformer-based parsers in low-resource regimes, while Transformers regain their advantage only as training data increases, suggesting the Biaffine LSTM is better suited for syntactic tool development in low-resource languages.
